info.title: Transit serving and reactive API
info.description: Provisioned native Ed25519 proofs in JSON bodies; exact HTTPS Host/Origin. Current service policy, native grants, source declarations, session generations and leases are runtime requirements. Ingress receipts are distinct from committed application outcomes. No bearer credential is accepted in URLs.

post.description: Fetch-streaming SSE after consuming one authenticated challenge and observing the signed attachment commit. Each SSE item has event/data and an optional id; data is a JSON-encoded ServerMessage. The challenge and streaming POST must use the same gateway. Event IDs are the lowercase-hex canonical signed cursor. Resume must match Last-Event-ID and the signed read cursor. A terminal event or interruption ends streaming; it does not cancel accepted commands.
